m_v = f_v m, u_v, g_v

R = λa, σ_LL

Reference cavity a = 300 nm; outer gel B a = 6 μm
p_l − p₀ = p_el(R) + 2σ_LL/R
Free outer traction; rigid motion removed
Gel: G, K, F = I + ∇d, J = det(F)
No imposed radius, shape or cavity displacement
Closed intact gel: no specified exterior liquid pathway
m = 4πa³ρ_D/3: cold PFP inventory; f_v: vapor mass fraction; V = V_l + V_v = 4πR³/3; A = 4πR².
ρ_D, T₀: cold liquid density and reference temperature; Q_dep: retained energy; U = m[(1−f_v)u_l + f_v u_v].
g_l, g_v: specific Gibbs energy; p_l, p_v: absolute phase pressures; σ_LL, σ_LV: constant interface reference coefficients.
W(F), W_s: gel energy density / integrated elastic work; G, K: shear / bulk modulus; λ_max: maximum principal stretch.
C_R: restoring stiffness, positive for radial stability; V_D, A_D, U_D: cold reference values; α: assumed gel thermal diffusivity.
Π: elastic + interface − internal pressure imbalance; λ_f = 2.1: cited uniaxial proxy; S: total PFP entropy; t_th = a²/α.
